personas.name: stat-suspected-sepsis-blood-culture-no-collection-time-caution
personas.description: Suspected sepsis on the ward (NEWS2 7): blood culture is the recommended (ideal) specimen for the suspected-sepsis indication, and the indication itself auto-escalates triage to stat (NICE NG51) regardless of the routine urgency requested; but no collection date/time was recorded for this transport-sensitive specimen, and this engine's stricter recommendation logic means that pre-analytical caution alone — not just reject-risk — forces query-referrer, even on a stat-tier request: triage acuity and vetting recommendation are orthogonal here — expect usually-appropriate + caution pre-analytical + stat + query-referrer.

personas.name: reject-pyrexia-unknown-origin-blood-culture-on-antibiotics-incomplete
personas.description: Pyrexia of unknown origin with blood cultures drawn after empirical antibiotics were already started: blood culture is the recommended (ideal) specimen for the pyrexia-unknown-origin indication, but taking it while the patient is on antibiotics is a critical pre-analytical problem (compromised yield) that forces reject-risk and, uniquely among the vetting outcomes exercised so far, a `reject` recommendation — this overrides even the otherwise-appropriate specimen choice, ahead of any appropriateness or completeness check; several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + reject-risk pre-analytical + routine + reject, completeness below 100.
